command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo
git fetch origin chatgpt-work/voice-full-integration-20260912
WT=/tmp/frank-voice-resume-20260912-1702
rm -rf "$WT"
git worktree add --detach "$WT" FETCH_HEAD >/dev/null
cleanup(){ git -C /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo worktree remove -f "$WT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$WT"
echo BRANCH_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -m py_compile scripts/frankenstein_identity_assembly.py scripts/voice_full_integration.py scripts/voice_host_agent.py scripts/frank_terminal.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_frankenstein_identity_assembly.py tests/test_voice_full_integration.py tests/test_frank_terminal.py tests/test_voice_host_broker.py
echo '--- SERVICES ---'
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service || true
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-voice-client.service || true
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-voice-optimizer.service || true
echo '--- VOICE ENV PRESENT (names only) ---'
ENV=$(systemctl --user show-environment || true)
for k in FRANK_VOICE_MACHINE_ID FRANK_VOICE_OWNER FRANK_VOICE_PERSON FRANK_VOICE_DB_PATH FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN; do if printf '%s\n' "$ENV" | grep -q "^${k}="; then echo "${k}=present"; else echo "${k}=missing"; fi; done
echo '--- PRODUCTION BROWSER COUNT ---'
pgrep -fa 'chrome|chromium' | wc -l || true
